## Summary

I implemented the bulk-signup warning in `OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`. When a newly created owner's telephone shares its area code (first three digits) with five or more existing owners, it now emits a WARN to the `AUDIT` logger in addition to the existing INFO creation record.

Changes in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java`:

- **`addOwner`**: computes `countOwnersSharingAreaCode` *before* the owner is persisted (so the new owner isn't counted among the "existing" owners), then after the INFO audit line, emits `AUDIT.warn(...)` when that count reaches the threshold.
- **`BULK_SIGNUP_AREA_CODE_THRESHOLD`** constant (5).
- **`areaCode(String)`**: extracts the first three digits of a normalized telephone, returning `null` if there are fewer than three digits.
- **`countOwnersSharingAreaCode(String)`**: counts existing owners whose normalized telephone shares the area code, reusing the existing `normalizeTelephone` logic for consistency with how numbers are stored/compared.

The area-code matching reuses `normalizeTelephone` so differently-punctuated numbers are compared on digits only, matching the rest of the class's telephone handling. The cp20 acceptance tests (`coreWarnsOnBulkAreaCode`, `functionalityNoWarnBelowThreshold`) pass, as do all 295 tests in the suite.
